description: AllpaNina (Quechua for “earth” and “fire”) merges NASA’s MODIS and VIIRS fire detections into one consistent long-term record. VIIRS sees more fires than MODIS, so joining them creates a false jump. We calibrate VIIRS per Peruvian department with a fixed factor κ (2013–2022), validated and tested once on reserved data: WAPE drops from 4.30 to 0.31. The site offers a monthly calendar and map for Peru, and lets anyone process any region in the browser with NASA FIRMS files.
